name: design-engineering
description: Design engineering for AI agents — animation timing, transitions, typography, color, components, layout, accessibility, anti-patterns, sound, SVG, launch films, faux product UI. Plus a SOUL.md identity layer and thirteen subagents (ten workflow agents plus a cross-model design council, a design judge and a design grader), generated for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and eve. Distills Emil Kowalski, Benji Taylor, Jakub Antalik (transitions.dev), guidelines.sh, Vercel, Ben DC, DiceBear, lucide-animated, Google Labs design.md, Agentation.

interface.longDescription: One skill, one entry: /design-engineering [verb] [target] reaches a navigable graph of 177 atomic nodes in thirteen clusters (philosophy, motion, sound, svg, diagrams, launch films, faux UI, typography, surface, components, layout, anti-patterns, meta). Verbs: review, polish, motion, mobile, break, tells, a11y, tokens, sound, svg, ship, film, stage, diagram, options, pick, name, which, agentation, pov, council, grade. Thirteen subagents (ten workflow agents plus the design council, judge and grader) in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and eve forms, a SOUL.md identity layer and an AGENTS.md operating guide.
